parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside in `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTestUtilities/Harness/PlayerControllerTestHarness.swift`, a test harness file. The structural similarity (Jaccard 0.83) between `postInterruptionBegan` and `postInterruptionEnded` reflects the symmetric nature of interruption lifecycle events in test scaffolding, not an accidental duplication that warrants generic parameterization. Merging these into a single generic helper would obscure the distinct semantic intent of each method (began vs. ended) and couple test infrastructure to an abstraction that serves no production purpose.
